topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture theme and outlines the expected learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution.

topics.label: Genetic selection and epigenetic alterations in cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how clonal succession driven by Darwinian natural selection and non-mutational epigenetic changes facilitate tumor development.

topics.label: Stem cell properties and cell of origin in tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess the cancer stem cell hypothesis and present experimental evidence from leukemia and colorectal cancer determining which cell types initiate malignancy.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal dependence in tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory signals, environmental promoters, and supportive stromal interactions cooperate with mutations to drive tumor development.

topics.label: Methods for analysing and integrating multifaceted cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss modern profiling technologies for investigating tumors and synthesize the interacting mutational, cellular, and microenvironmental factors that govern cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks for the session and previews the upcoming lecture on therapy.
